dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Uncomplicated post-operative recovery following recent abdominal surgery, with the binder in place to provide abdominal wall support and reduce wound tension.

Alternatives to consider:
1. Recent ventral hernia repair (binder used to prevent recurrence)
2. Recent major upper abdominal surgery such as gastrectomy or pancreatic resection
3. Recent liver or renal transplantation (binder used to support the incision)
